card.title: One Tiny Imperfection
card.instruction: Choose one tiny imperfection and let it steadily outweigh every larger concern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we hand over the house keys, can we straighten that hallway frame?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The buyers are waiting. Our taxi's outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They're standing right under it. They'll think we left it like that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They just hung it. It's theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give them the keys. I'll stay and show them how to look after the frame.
